claims.claim: Dates the Protocol 27 Mainnet vote to July 8, 2026.
claims.notes: The guide gives the vote schedule. The dated ledger confirms Mainnet activation that day.

claims.claim: Gives July 8, 2026 as the official Protocol 27 Mainnet date.

sources.quote: current_protocol_version=27; history_latest_ledger=64193999. The latest-ledger probe returned sequence 64194000 and protocol_version=27.

claims.notes: The software table supplies the official date. Horizon confirms Protocol 27 remains live.

claims.claim: CAP-0071-01 adds authentication delegation for custom accounts.

sources.quote: Add a built-in way for custom (smart contract) accounts to delegate the authentication logic to other addresses.
New features in Zipper, Protocol 27: Authentication Delegation and Address-Bound Soroban Credentials: CAP-71.

claims.claim: CAP-0071-02 adds SOROBAN_CREDENTIALS_ADDRESS_V2 with an address-bound payload.

sources.quote: Add SOROBAN_CREDENTIALS_ADDRESS_V2 so non-delegated address credentials can use the address-bound Soroban authorization payload.
Authentication Delegation and Address-Bound Soroban Credentials: CAP-71.

claims.notes: CAP-0071-02 also says: “However, in the future protocol (28 or later) we may want to consider deprecating the old credential type and preimage type.” It does not mandate Protocol 28 deprecation.

evidenceLines: Live re-check 2026-08-30: https://stellar.org/blog/foundation-news/stellar-zipper-protocol-27-upgrade-guide — the guide gives July 8, 2026 as the Mainnet vote date.
Live re-check 2026-08-30: https://developers.stellar.org/docs/networks/software-versions — the heading is Protocol 27 (Mainnet, July 8, 2026).
Live re-check 2026-08-30: https://github.com/stellar/stellar-protocol/blob/master/core/cap-0071-01.md — the CAP adds built-in custom-account auth delegation.
Live re-check 2026-08-30: https://github.com/stellar/stellar-protocol/blob/master/core/cap-0071-02.md — the CAP adds address-bound V2 credentials.
siblingSweep: Sibling sweep 2026-08-30: grep Protocol 27|Zipper|CAP-0071 → q-pc-protocol-upgrade-timing, q-protocol-27-cap-0071, q-protocol-version-history-list, q-soroban-auth-delegation-p27 and related cases; no contradiction
overallNotes: The 2026-08-30 Horizon root returned current_protocol_version=27, core_supported_protocol_version=28, and history_latest_ledger=64193999. A separate latest-ledger query returned sequence 64194000 with protocol_version=27. Protocol 28 is not live on Mainnet today. Core software supports 28, but the live network protocol is 27. The software heading is “Protocol 27 (Mainnet, July 8, 2026).” CAP-0071-02 says Protocol 28 “or later” may consider deprecation; it does not state that Protocol 28 performs it.
